scripts.tauri:prepare-api: npm run build:api && dotnet publish GameApi/GameApi.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true /p:PublishSingleFile=true /p:IncludeAllContentForSelfExtract=true -o src-tauri/binaries/_publish && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='src-tauri/binaries';fs.copyFileSync(p+'/_publish/GameApi.exe', p+'/GameApi-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe');fs.rmSync(p+'/_publish',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('sidecar ready')"
